items.item_text: Experience with server virtualization platforms such as Proxmox, KVM, VMware, or comparable technologies, and enterprise or research storage technologies including network-attached storage, SANs, ZFS, backup and recovery systems, and high-volume scientific data transfer.

Experience with Linux/Unix infrastructure and network services, including technologies such as NFS, Samba, Kerberos, FreeBSD, pfSense, managed switches, VLANs, routing, firewalls, and network segmentation.

Experience designing, administering, or modernizing research-computing infrastructure supporting shared facilities and scientific workflows, including workload schedulers such as Slurm, infrastructure automation or configuration management tools, and integration between local systems and institutional HPC or other shared computing resources.

Ability to translate technical and research requirements into scalable infrastructure designs and long-range technology roadmaps that appropriately balance security, reliability, performance, lifecycle, cost, and available resources.
